method_selection: No prompt, scope, order, coefficient, aggregation or per-model policy changes after reading these sampled cases. Keep calibrated vote as current candidate, order0 and uncalibrated vote as matched controls, and both plain/chat sequence metrics.
qualification: Identify at least two native candidates and specific before/new observations changing their relative diagnostic support. A final diagnosis or temporal keyword alone is insufficient. Keep original text, all candidates and source reference; do not invent counterfactual reference labels.
outcomes: Record candidate pair, before/new evidence, reason and included/excluded/pending for every sampled row without using model predictions. Coexistence, an unchanged final answer or image mentions alone are not exclusions. Duplicate candidate names are an adapter coverage issue, not proof of invalid source data.
stopping: Review all32 preselected groups. Do not replace ineligible or failed items based on model performance; report every exclusion/pending disposition and the resulting denominator before scoring.
selection: Random32 from input-keyword groups after excluding all24 prior development cases and exact normalized duplicates. Native candidate strings are sorted before review so the correct-column identity is not displayed.
scoring: Author native four-choice reference remains unchanged; no source target identity in model inputs. Full-case diagnosis accuracy only, not paired CF consistency. Cross-source overlap and necessary-modality checks must precede independent claims.
scope: Potential independent evidence within this qualified keyword-screened CUPCase subset. No claim of random coverage of all3562 rows, clinical-expert adjudication, unseen pretraining or clinical deployment.
label_access: Four source candidate columns read for the32 selected rows; correct-column identity discarded in review artifact. No gold identity printed or model prediction produced.
reason: All24 prior development cases have a unique terminal-period candidate equal to source gold. First4 new input/candidate sets also display this style difference; their gold identities were not queried. Preserve sample, do not call its raw four-choice score independent mechanism evidence.
exposure_update: First4 newly read cases are now additional development exposure because their candidate style prompted an adapter control. Remaining28 case/candidate texts have not been displayed to the reviewer.
